name: aspen-code
description: Customize an Aspen instance with the aspen CLI: one skill (using-aspen) that is the whole loop — find a real component's shape under metacode/compiled/, author into metacode/metadata/, compile, deploy, verify — plus a session-start hook that injects the CLI's own command list, a guard that asks before commands clearing the shared dev set, and a guard that denies writes into the generated platform/compiled/active tiers.
